title: Mortal Shell 2
summary: Unreal Engine 5 titles that crash on the first cutscene. The carrier sits under a compiler-named subfolder, which the script discovers rather than assumes.

excerpts.note: Sets Electra.Win.H264UseOldOutputPath, found by its own name rather than by an address, so Electra takes its CPU buffer path and never the D3D one.

cause: On a D3D12 device Electra takes its GPU output buffer path, which asks every D3D12 resource for ID3DDestructionNotifier and uses the answer without checking it; under D3DMetal there is none, and it reads address 0.
